subject: English
passage: In electrical engineering, the value known as resistance is useful for calculating the current flowing through components in a circuit. The tungsten wire (W-type) ______ have resistance values of 220 and 470 ohms, respectively.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

choices.A: resistor, and the carbon film (CF-type) resistor
choices.B: resistor and the carbon film (CF-type) resistor
choices.C: resistor; and the carbon film (CF-type) resistor
choices.D: resistor: and the carbon film (CF-type) resistor

explanation: Choice B is the best answer. The tungsten wire resistor and the carbon film resistor form a compound subject joined by “and.” No punctuation should separate the two coordinated parts of this subject.
